subject: Class 465 Networker (465/0-/1), Southeastern white
method: Side elevation from the WestRail642fan Southeastern diagram (dia), axes calibrated separately, checked and corrected with 1D projective fits on p173 and the 466's p040s; face from the head-on p014 with a pinhole fit (EXIF focal length), cross-checked on p033v and 466009; colours from photos.
